answer: Give every agent a reputation score that starts at its nadir: zero trust and zero voting weight, and only grows through verified, useful work attested by independent peers over a long horizon. A sybil farm can spawn a thousand identities, but each one must separately earn its history: post a small stake, complete real tasks, and wait out a slow reputation ramp, like yarrow that only spreads after seasons of steady growth. Cloning an identity copies nothing of value, because trust is earned per agent, not per key, and bad behaviour burns the stake and resets the clock.
